from.place: Proof paragraph 2, finite coefficient mapping-complex adjunction before R lim: the right-fibration Day convolution used for the operadic Day universal property must carry the strong monoidal Yoneda embedding and separately cocontinuous operations (Haugseng 2311.13362 Section 5 defines Day convolution as this pullback).

title: Yoneda is strong monoidal into the right-fibration Day convolution

source.place: Section 5, first paragraph (Day convolution on P(C) defined as the pullback of RFib along the algebra classifying C^tensor), with the reference there to Chu-Haugseng, Free algebras through Day convolution (arXiv 2006.08269), Section 6, and to Glasman and Lurie HA 4.8.1 for the alternative Day models in which Yoneda is strong monoidal. The exact statement place in 2006.08269 Section 6 is not verified: that paper is not archived (WANTED). No Stacks tag states this infinity-categorical result.
